Attempts to reproduce published results as closely as the available compute and data allow.

Each entry states up front which numbers from the paper it targets, what was reproduced, what was not, and where the reproduction departs from the original setup. A result that fails to reproduce is reported as a failure rather than tuned until it agrees.
